records.text: Menachem Begin gifted Jerry Falwell Sr. a Learjet in 1979.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: in 1979, Jerry Falwell Sr. was gifted a Learjet from the founder of the Likud party, then prime minister of Israel, Menachem Begin.

verification.notes: Multiple independent historical accounts describe the Israeli government or Menachem Begin providing Jerry Falwell with a Learjet in 1979. The transfer is well documented in secondary histories, though a primary transfer record was not located.

sources.relevance: Historical scholarly account states Israel presented Falwell with a private jet in May 1979.
